title: Limit-Aware Wrapup config
description: Config for the limit-wrapup sensor/trigger. Lives at ~/.claude/limit-wrapup/config.json. Every field is optional: anything missing, misspelled, or out of range falls back to a safe default (the runtime is fail-open and never throws on bad config). Units are account-% of a usage window, never tokens.

$schema.description: Path/URL to this schema, for editor autocomplete + hover docs. Not read by the tool.

enabled.description: Master kill-switch. false silences all decision logic (the hook still no-ops cheaply).

mode.description: warn = informational heads-ups only, never forces a wrap (attended). auto = also emits a hard WRAPUP directive once a window passes (100 - reserve)%, for unattended sessions. Any other value is treated as 'warn'.

plan.description: Selects the reserve fallback (fallback_reserve_pct) ONLY until wrapup_cost_measured or reserve_pct is set. pro is the most conservative.

warn_at.description: Heads-up thresholds (account-%, exclusive 0-100). A flat array applies to both windows; an object sets each window independently.

reserve_pct.description: The wrap-point knob: auto-wrap fires at (100 - reserve_pct)%. Set directly (e.g. 1.5 -> wrap at 98.5%). Overrides the measured/fallback reserve. null = derive from wrapup_cost_measured x margin, else the plan fallback. Clamped to [0.5, 10].

wrapup_cost_measured.description: Account-% one wrap-up ritual costs, from calibration runs. When set (and reserve_pct is null), reserve = this x wrapup_reserve_margin.

wrapup_reserve_margin.description: Safety factor over wrapup_cost_measured (ritual cost scales with context/diff size). Only used when reserve_pct is null and wrapup_cost_measured is set.

fallback_reserve_pct.description: Per-plan reserve used only until a measured value or reserve_pct lands.

dry_run.description: true = log decisions to decisions.log but inject nothing (observe before trusting). Flip to false to let heads-ups/WRAPUP directives actually reach the session.

notify.description: Show a native desktop notification when an (unattended) WRAPUP fires, so the auto-wrap is seen and not just discovered later as a wip/ branch. Only fires on WRAPUP, never on a heads-up. Fail-open: a missing toast subsystem is silently ignored.

stale_after_min.description: Sensor samples older than this (minutes) are treated as unknown -> silent (fail-open).

suppress_warn_if_reset_within_min.description: Cheap cliff: if the window resets within this many minutes, being cut off costs only minutes, so suppress the warn/wrap.
